summary: Consolidate multiple Figma organizations, optimize seat allocation, and procure SSO-enabled licenses
description:
Issue summary: Redwood teams currently span three separate Figma organizations created during rapid hiring and acquisitions. We need to consolidate into a single org, standardize seat types (Editor vs Viewer), enable SSO via our Okta tenant, and procure additional floating Editor seats for design contractors.

Impact: Ongoing friction for cross-team collaboration, duplicated billing lines across GL codes, inconsistent access controls (some teams lack SSO enforcement), and higher per-seat costs due to fragmented purchases. Estimated immediate impact: ~25 designers and contractors with delayed onboarding; medium-term impact: reduced efficiency for product/design reviews.

Background: Design, Product, and Growth each have their own Figma orgs. Contractors are currently on month-to-month Editor seats billed to team budgets. Legal and Finance want a single contract for compliance and simplified invoicing. IT requires SSO + SCIM provisioning for lifecycle management. Procurement should negotiate volume pricing and secure a PO for annual billing.

Requirements / Acceptance criteria: 1) Create plan to migrate two smaller orgs into primary Redwood Figma org with minimal disruption. 2) Purchase 40 Editor floating seats and 120 Viewer seats under a single annual enterprise license, with ability to add monthly floating Editors for contractors. 3) SSO (Okta) must be enabled and SCIM provisioning tested for user creation/deactivation. 4) Single consolidated invoice (monthly or annual as negotiated) to be routed to Finance GL 4-12345. 5) Migration runbook and rollback process documented in Confluence page. 6) No loss of file ownership or team permissions during migration; targeted migration window communicated 14 days in advance.

Estimated costs and timeline: Procurement estimate: $60k-$85k/year depending on tier and discount. Timebox: discovery and vendor negotiation 2 weeks, SSO/SCIM integration 1 week, migration and validation 1 week (target completion by 2026-03-28).

Suggested next steps: 1) Procurement to open vendor negotiation and request enterprise quote with SSO and SCIM; 2) IT to provision Okta test app and provide SCIM service account for vendor; 3) Finance to confirm billing GL and PO process; 4) Requester to provide list of active Editor accounts and contractors.

Notes: This is an internal procurement request (no external customer). Please include legal review for DPA if vendor requires one.
comments: 2026-03-10 Priya Kapoor: Opening ticket to consolidate Figma orgs. Attached initial inventory CSV via shared drive link (https://redwood.atlassian.link/figma-inventory-2026-03-09). Primary ask: standardize SSO and reduce duplicate invoices.

2026-03-11 Marco Rivera (Procurement): Acknowledged. I'll request enterprise quotes from Figma and alternative vendors for vendor leverage. Can you confirm expected permanent Editor headcount vs contractors? We need accurate numbers for negotiating discounts.

2026-03-11 Priya Kapoor: Permanent Editors ~35 (product + design + research), contractors vary but typically 5-10 concurrently. Prefer 40 floating Editors to cover peak load and hires. Viewers ~120 across orgs.

2026-03-12 Aisha Patel (IT): Okta team can enable SSO and SCIM. Need a test tenant, SCIM credentials, and vendor sandbox. We'll run a dry-run for provisioning before migration. Note: SCIM provisioning requires an admin service account; confirm if vendor supports service accounts in the quote.

2026-03-12 Evan Chen (Finance): Finance OK to fund under GL 4-12345 pending formal quote. For annual contracts >$50k we'll need a PO and approval from Procurement Director. Please include invoice cadence options in quotes.

2026-03-13 Marco Rivera: Received enterprise quote from Figma sales (attached as link https://vendors.redwood/figma-quote-27645). Initial tiered pricing shows 18% discount at 40+ editors. Legal requested DPA and export controls clause; pinged Legal Ops with initial contract language.

2026-03-13 Legal Ops (Sasha Novak): Reviewed vendor standard DPA. Proposed 2 redlines around data retention and subprocessors. Waiting on vendor acceptance; recommended 48-hour turnaround if vendor agrees to redlines.

2026-03-14 Marco Rivera: Engaging vendor for SCIM sandbox access and asking for consolidated billing terms. Drafting PO and will attach final contract once Legal confirms redlines. Target migration week proposed 2026-03-22 pending SCIM test results.

2026-03-14 Priya Kapoor: Noted. I will coordinate communications to design teams and schedule migration blackout windows. Also attaching list of shared files that need explicit preservation during transfer.
